answer: A single Stoneware whiteware glazer clay licence does the work of a whole committee: a licence whiteware glazers carry after glazing room audits, verified by a stranger. A farm running 454 aliases pays 454 times over: 51756 POA locked against one honest agent's single stake. A lagoon earned slowly, a pearl paid plainly, and a garden kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
